verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs describe a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and drives policies, risks, and evidence. The platform also offers pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection with AI evidence-gap checks, audit-partner selection, and in-platform collaboration with the auditor, which covers running a SOC 2 program end to end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Type I vs Type II audit paths, explicit mapping to the Trust Services Criteria, depth beyond summary-level doc snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SOC 2 workflow.
